title: Page style is the six presets
change: Page style shows the six presets as small previews of the rep's own page, plus the logo. The Color, Background, Fonts, Size and Corners rows are gone.
evidence: Font, size, corner or background overrides appear on 10 customer pages from 5 owners.
notes: The preview tiles are hand-built from each preset's colors, fonts and shapes in theme-presets.ts. The preset web fonts (Fraunces, Anton, Cormorant Garamond and others) could not be downloaded here, so the tiles fall back to Georgia, Impact, Hoefler Text and Avenir Next. The hero video is a neutral poster with a silhouette. No preset is selected, as on the before page.
